jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
#### **Deine Aufgaben**

* Entwicklung neuer Features im Backend mit Python, FastAPI und PostgreSQL/PostGIS
* Umsetzung des Frontends in Next.js, von interaktiven Karten über Formulare bis zur Datenansicht
* Aufbau von Datenpipelines, die Geodaten, Messreihen und KI\-gestützte Auswertungen ins Produkt bringen
* Integration fachlicher Rechenkerne wie Windberechnungen, gemeinsam mit den Expert:innen der Gruppe
* Verantwortung für ein eigenes Modul, inklusive Tests, Code Reviews und Deployment

#### **Dein Profil**

* Du hast mindestens drei Jahre professionell Software entwickelt, ob nach einem Studium der Informatik oder Physik oder auf einem anderen Weg.
* Python schreibst du sicher im Backend, und in React oder Next.js fühlst du dich zu Hause.
* SQL und saubere Datenmodelle sind für dich Handwerkszeug, kein Nebenthema.
* Du hast Features schon von der Idee bis in die Produktion gebracht und übernimmst gern Verantwortung für das, was du baust.
* Idealerweise hast du bereits in einem dynamischen Umfeld wie einem Start\-up gearbeitet und weißt, wie man mit wenig Vorgaben pragmatisch zu guten Lösungen kommt.
* KI\-Tools gehören für dich selbstverständlich zum Arbeitsalltag.
* Erfahrung mit Geodaten oder im Energiebereich ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
* Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

#### **Das Portfolio Unternehmen**


Wir besetzen die Position im Portfolio:


Die **Energy and Climate Consulting Group** vereint mit GEO\-NET, anemos, planGIS, IEL und I17\-Wind mehrere der führenden, unabhängigen Beratungs\- und Technologieunternehmen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien, Umweltmeteorologie und Klimaanalytik, deren Gutachten und Analysen darüber entscheiden, ob ein Windpark gebaut oder finanziert wird.


Was dabei in den vergangenen Jahren entstanden ist, ist zugleich einer der größten ungehobenen Datenschätze der Branche: Potenzialstudien, Ertragsgutachten, akkreditierte Messreihen, Klimamodelle und Marktwertanalysen. Auf diesem Fundament entsteht jetzt ein eigenständiges Produkt, das mit deiner Hilfe zum neuen Industriestandard für Windenergie\-Gutachten wird.

#### **Deine Perspektive**

* Dich erwartet ein hochmotiviertes Team und ein Produkt kurz vor Markteintritt, bei dem dein Code in Tagen live geht statt in Quartalen
* Du arbeitest in einer fachlich anspruchsvollen Domäne zwischen Windphysik, Geodaten und Regulatorik
* Du hast Zugriff auf einen Datenbestand, den es in der Branche so kein zweites Mal gibt
* Wir bieten dir räumliche Flexibilität mit 1–2 Bürotagen in Hamburg

#### **Über uns**


Der Klimawandel ist die größte Herausforderung unserer Zeit. Wir sind überzeugt, dass die Antwort darauf unternehmerisch sein muss und investieren gezielt in mittelständische Unternehmen, die mit ihren Produkten und Dienstleistungen zur Dekarbonisierung der Wirtschaft beitragen.


Was uns dabei auszeichnet: Wir bringen nicht nur Kapital, sondern vor allem operative Erfahrung und echten Gestaltungsanspruch. Partnerschaftlich und auf Augenhöhe mit den Geschäftsführungen unserer Portfoliounternehmen verfolgen wir ein Ziel: marktfähige Klimaschutzlösungen wettbewerbsfähiger machen, skalieren und damit einen messbaren Beitrag zur Energiewende leisten.

jobs.title: Developer Full-Stack React
jobs.description:
**What is Equisoft?** Equisoft is a global provider of digital solutions for insurance, wealth, and investment, trusted by more than 250 of the world’s largest financial institutions. Our UK team builds and runs leading SaaS platforms used across the pensions and investment industries — helping financial\-services firms move, invest, and manage client assets efficiently and securely.  



  

**Why Choose Equisoft?** We’re at an exciting point in our UK growth. Our products are established and respected, but we’re now evolving our technology — introducing Docker, a modern C\# and JavaScript framework, and new engineering practices that will shape how we build for years to come.


It’s a great time to join if you enjoy being part of change: patient enough to understand that transformation takes time, but eager to help make it happen.


You’ll join a small, influential team that punches well above its weight in the industry. Your ideas and contribution will genuinely matter here. We value curiosity, initiative, and attention to detail far more than formal qualifications. We’re looking for people who want to understand the financial\-services domain, not just the tech, and who care about being part of a team rather than just holding a role.  



  

You’ll find us in our new Bath office where we all meet on Wednesdays and Thursdays — the rest of the week is flexible and remote if you desire.  



* H iring Location: UK (Bath)
* Full\-time permanent role
* Internal job title: Developer
* Salary between £45,000 to £50,000
* Benefits from day 1: Private Medical Insurance, Life Insurance, Pension Matched Contribution, etc.
* Number of hours per week: 37\.5
* Flexible hours
Educational Support (LinkedIn Learning and dedicated training time)  
* 

  

**Your Role:** You’ll join a close\-knit group of developers reporting to the development manager, working on some of the UK’s most trusted fintech products — including Equisoft/transfer, /pay, /trade and Pension Fusion.


These SaaS solutions power key processes for leading investment and pension providers: transferring portfolios, handling pension payroll and tax reporting, and providing data for the UK Government’s Pensions Dashboard Programme — a national initiative that will let individuals see all their pensions in one place.


We’re looking for a developer with a focus on front\-end technologies, particularly **React** , to help modernize our products. We’re not just looking for someone to build what’s in front of them — we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us, contribute ideas, and help shape the front\-end of our products. As all our developers work across the full stack, you should also be comfortable working with other technologies such as .NET, C\# and SQL Server.  



**Your Day with Equisoft:**

* Design and implement new features and products and build upon the application architecture for our range of software\-as\-a\-service (SaaS) products. For us, this means writing code that is user centric, robust, high\-performance and secure.
* Most of your development time will be spent with .NET and C\# but we require all developers to work with our JavaScript front\-end and our SQL Server database as well.
* Conduct unit testing, using a test\-driven development approach where appropriate and work closely with the test team to ensure the quality of the software.
* Submit your code for review by colleagues to identify issues early.
* Review your colleagues’ code. We want to benefit from your input and expertise!
Actively participating in the various agile meetings (the daily, retrospective, etc.) of your team. We want to hear your opinions!  
* 

**Requirements:**

**Technical**

* Around 3–5 years’ experience as a developer (or equivalent capability).
* Experience with front\-end technologies: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS and HTML
* Comfortable working across a stack including C\#, .NET and SQL Server.
* Experience collaborating in small, cross\-functional teams.
Clear written and spoken English.  
* 

We care more about skill, curiosity, and drive than about degrees. If you’ve learned your craft through experience rather than academia, that’s absolutely fine.  



**Soft skills**

* Enthusiastic about software development, continued learning and improvement.
* A strong problem\-solver.
* A good eye for detail and show consideration for end\-user interactions.
* Initiative\-taking and enthusiastic.
* Strong sense of organization and prioritizing.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate, write and synthesize information.
* Ability to multi\-task in a rapid\-paced environment.
Team spirit, tact, diplomacy, autonomy, rigor, and discipline.  
* 

**Nice to Haves**

* Experience with Entity Framework (Core).
* Experience working within Agile Methodology.

An interest in financial services and/or pensions.  

* 

**Diversity \& Inclusion**

Equisoft is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior software engineer - EU squad
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------


London


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


Hybrid


**Department**
--------------


Engineering


  
*Hybrid working based at one of our offices in London, Bath or Edinburgh. Your contract will be hybrid, although we don’t currently require a set number of office days. We support flexible working and trust teams to agree how and where they work best, taking a pragmatic approach based on the needs of the role and team.*

  


**About us**
------------


Seccl is the Octopus\-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

  

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl\-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

  

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household\-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

  

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long\-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high\-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

  

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

  



**Our culture:**
----------------


**Never settle –** We think of ourselves as ‘embedded hero\-makers’ for our customers. We put them first, and if we say we’ll do something, we’ll move heaven and earth to do it. We think boldly and embrace change.


**Take ownership \-** We think rigorously and deeply about a problem, but then charge at it, acting with and urgency and speed that sets us apart. But we never lose sight of quality or long\-term scalability.


**Be generous \& candid \-** We encourage our people – and our customers – to challenge us and never shy away from tough conversations. We have a flat and inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves – and speak up.

  



**Our engineering ways of working:**
------------------------------------


* Our Product and Engineering organisation is structured into four tribes: Custody, Accounts, Experience, and Cloud \& Security. Each tribe contains multiple autonomous squads, with clear full ownership over specific product domains.
* The squads are intentionally small and cross\-functional, typically made up of an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and 3–5 engineers with complementary skills aligned to the domain they own.
* We operate in a build\-and\-run model, with teams responsible for the full software lifecycle, from architecture and delivery through to operational support and incident management.
* Our core platform is built on AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, and ECS. We primarily develop in **TypeScript and Node.js,** with **MongoDB** as our primary document database. We also have a small number of C\# services and are continuing to evolve our platform architecture, including expanding our use of ECS Fargate.
* Infrastructure is managed through a combination of Terraform and Serverless Framework. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD and incident.io to support our incident management processes and operational workflows.
* We care deeply about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. If you’d like to go deeper, we’re happy to share more about our engineering practices and technology radar during the interview process.

**The role**
------------


As an engineer at Seccl you will design, build and operate reliable and scalable, testable and maintainable software solutions, building new functionalities and products using **Typescript and Node.js.** You play a key role in our software development and have a hands\-on approach throughout the development process supporting resilient financial workflow systems and regulated investment operations. As a senior member of the team, you are the ‘go\-to’ person for queries.

  


**On a typical day you will…**
------------------------------


* Work collaboratively in a domain aligned cross\-functional squad made up of engineers and product along with colleagues from customer\-facing and operations teams
* Design, implement and operate your services within your domain
* Be accountable for the SLAs of your products and iterative improvements
* Maintain and extend documentation for your services
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence while understanding when “good enough for now” is appropriate
* Provide guidance and mentorship for other engineers
* Communicate with non\-technical colleagues to answer queries about the Seccl system

**What you need…**
------------------


* To own your services from design to operation. We operate a build\-and\-run model where engineers have autonomy but full accountability.
* We care deeply about correctness, resilience and operational excellence because our systems underpin real customer investments.
* Engineers are not passengers in their products but champions. Drive improvements and features while collaborating openly with product, operations and engineering colleagues, challenging ideas constructively and focusing on delivering the best outcomes for customers.
* Have a strong ability to understand business and customer problems and turn them into efficient, scalable solutions. Be curious about how investment and custody products operate, and pragmatic in balancing customer value, operational correctness, engineering quality and long\-term scalability.
* Experience building financial systems with multi\-region, multi\-currency or trading\-related complexity would be advantageous.
* Experience in a strongly/statically typed language.
* Have a strong understanding of designing, building, and running high\-quality, standards\-compliant workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance.
* Have worked with a cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP). We use AWS.
* Have worked with distributed systems and are comfortable debugging through tracing and observability.
* Willing to be on\-call for your services.

**Core technical skills you must have:**
----------------------------------------


* Strong commercial experience with **Node.js**, specifically **TypeScript**
* Experience with **Amazon Web Services**
* Experience with Serverless products
* Experience with document databases, ideally **MongoDB**
* Experience mentoring engineers
* Experience leading technical delivery in a build\-and\-run engineering model
* Experience in a structured on\-call process and incident management
* Experience working in regulated industries, ideally financial services or FinTech.

**This role isn’t for you if...**
---------------------------------


* **You rely on a lot of top\-down direction.** Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression, bring forward ideas, and spot opportunities to improve
* **You’re not comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment.** Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet
* **You struggle to follow through on ideas.** We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen
* **You don’t like change**. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

**What’s in it for you…**
-------------------------


We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:


Base salary based on experience and skills demonstrated during our assessment phase


27 days holiday \+ bank holidays (some can be flexible) \+ day off on your birthday \+ three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave


Two volunteering days per year


Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years


✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance


Private medical insurance with AXA Health


Enhanced Parental leave


MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget


£750 per person learning budget


Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year


Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace


Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy


Perkbox – Flexi\-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts


Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

  


**Interview process**
---------------------


Interviewing is a two\-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this:


* **Talent screen** \- **30 min** intro call with our Talent partner or an Engineering manager
* **Bar raiser \- 40 min** with two Engineering leaders
* **Technical loop \- 2h** virtual technical assessment with 2 core components \- system design and TypeScript code review with breaks between the stages. You will receive preparation materials for the round and more information on how to prepare.
* We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out and you should expect to hear back from us within one to two weeks of applying.


Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

  

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. **We’d love to hear from you!**

jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Fintech/ Crypto
jobs.description:
**Hey! Nice to see you!**


At Incubly, we believe that great people want to work with great people, so we started to build a company that attracts great minds and enables us to achieve great things while genuinely enjoying what we do. Our mission is to support tech companies and startups (scaleups) in scaling their teams quickly and with high quality, while boosting product development, testing, and deployment so we can succeed together.


We are currently working with a French company that is a leader in security and infrastructure solutions for cryptocurrencies and blockchain applications. It has a team of more than 400 professionals developing a variety of products and services to safeguard cryptocurrency assets, including worldwide leading hardware wallets.


As a **Platform Engineer,** you will work closely with product engineering teams to improve the developer experience and remove friction from the build, package, and deployment process. You will own and improve developer tooling, self\-service platforms, golden paths, runners, registries, delivery tooling, and observability. You will collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure the platform is fast, reliable, secure, and easy to use, while using automation and strong systems thinking to help teams ship faster and more safely.
  

  

**Your daily responsibilities**


**CI/CD platform \& runner fleet**


* Own and evolve the self\-hosted GitHub Actions runner fleet, including Linux runners managed via Actions Runner Controller (ARC), self\-hosted macOS runners, and the Terraform modules that provision and scale self\-hosted infrastructure.
* Right\-size runner classes (CPU/memory/storage) against real workload profiles, balancing cost efficiency against engineering velocity, and supporting engineering teams in understanding and owning the resource footprint of their own jobs.
* Support the migration away from GitHub\-hosted runners, including evaluating trade\-offs between containerised and VM\-based execution for workloads with special hardware requirements (e.g. KVM access for Android emulators).
* Partner with embedded DevOps engineers on pipeline and dependency\-graph optimisations (build triggers, job fan\-out, monorepo change detection) to reduce queue times and unnecessary CI spend — you own the platform and runner layer these pipelines execute on.
* Investigate and resolve macOS virtualisation performance issues (e.g. Tart) and help evaluate alternative approaches such as remote simulator hosts.

**Artifact \& package management**


* Administer the JFrog Platform (Artifactory, Xray, Curation) as the organization’s primary artifact
  

repository, including repository structure, access control, vulnerability scanning policies, and
  

curation/allow\-listing of upstream dependencies.
* Provide light\-touch, minimal support for GitHub Container Registry (GHCR) and GitHub Packages where teams use them alongside JFrog.
* Operate and maintain ChartMuseum as the organization’s Helm chart repository, hosted on S3,
  

including storage lifecycle, access, and chart promotion workflows.
* Define and enforce container image ownership boundaries — platform\-owned hardened/minimal base images (e.g. Docker Hardened Images, Chainguard) versus engineering\-owned project extensions — and drive Dockerfile build and layer optimisation best practices across teams.

**Progressive delivery \& infrastructure automation**


* Operate two ArgoCD / Argo Rollouts environments, one serving internal tooling and one serving product workloads supporting GitOps\-based, progressive delivery (canary/blue\-green) patterns for engineering teams.
* Author, maintain, and support Helm charts and Kustomize overlays as the standard configuration management approach for Kubernetes workloads, providing golden\-path templates that reduce boilerplate for product teams.
* Design, review, and evolve Terraform and Terragrunt modules for infrastructure\-as\-code, including maintaining a public/internal module registry that product and platform teams can consume in a self\-service manner.

**Observability \& reliability**


* Improve and help unify the observability stack; Grafana, Prometheus, and Alertmanager. Fixing
  

metric accuracy issues, building meaningful dashboards, and defining SLOs/alerting that reflect real platform and pipeline health.
* Work across Datadog and VictoriaLogs/VictoriaMetrics to reduce tool sprawl, and help define a
  

coherent strategy for where metrics, logs, and events should live.
* Provide platform\-level telemetry (runner utilization, build queue times, artifact scan results, deployment health) that gives engineering teams and leadership a single, trustworthy view of pipeline and platform performance.

**Internal developer platform, policy \& modern workloads**


* Evaluate and help operate Crossplane as a control\-plane layer for self\-service, Kubernetes\-native infrastructure provisioning, complementing the existing Terraform/Terragrunt IaC estate.
* Contribute to a developer portal / internal catalogue strategy (e.g. Backstage, Cortex, or Port) so engineers have a single place to discover services, ownership, docs, and golden\-path templates.
* Implement and maintain policy\-as\-code guardrails using Kyverno and/or Open Policy Agent (OPA) across the Kubernetes and CI/CD estate (e.g. image provenance, resource limits, security baselines).
* Support Knative\-based serverless/event\-driven workloads on Kubernetes where teams need
  

scale\-to\-zero or request\-driven compute.
* Roll out OpenTelemetry instrumentation and pipelines to standardise traces, metrics, and logs across services, feeding the Grafana/Prometheus/Datadog/VictoriaLogs stack with consistent, correlated telemetry.

**Developer experience \& enablement**


* Act as the platform’s embedded point of contact for one or more product engineering teams:
  

Understand their day\-to\-day friction, prioritise platform work accordingly, and close the loop on
  

delivery.
* Build self\-service tooling, templates, and documentation (golden paths) so engineers can provision runners, publish artifacts, and deploy without needing deep platform expertise.
* Clearly document ownership boundaries between platform and product teams (e.g. base images vs. application extensions) and help engineering teams operate confidently within them.
* Contribute to the platform roadmap, bringing a developer\-experience lens to prioritisation — and measure success in terms of engineer\-facing outcomes such as build time, queue time, and self\-service adoption, not just infrastructure uptime.

**We need you to have**


**Experience \& technical skills**


* 5\+ years in a Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering role, ideally
  

supporting product engineering teams directly.
* Hands\-on experience with GitHub Actions, including self\-hosted runner architectures (Actions Runner Controller / Kubernetes\-based Linux runners, self\-hosted macOS runners) and provisioning them via Terraform.
* Practical knowledge of the JFrog Platform (Artifactory, Xray, and ideally Curation) for artifact
  

management and dependency security.
* Familiarity with container registries beyond a single vendor (GHCR/GitHub Packages) and Helm chart repositories such as ChartMuseum on object storage (S3\).
* Experience with GitOps continuous delivery using ArgoCD, and ideally Argo Rollouts for progressive delivery (canary/blue\-green) across multiple clusters/environments.
* Strong Kubernetes configuration management skills with Helm and Kustomize.
* Solid Infrastructure\-as\-Code experience with Terraform and Terragrunt, including designing and
  

consuming shared/reusable modules.
* Experience with Crossplane (or a comparable Kubernetes\-native control\-plane approach) for building self\-service infrastructure APIs, alongside deep Terraform proficiency for the underlying IaC.
* Experience building or operating an internal developer portal/software catalogue such as Backstage, Cortex, or Port, including modelling service ownership and scorecards.
* Hands\-on experience with policy\-as\-code enforcement in Kubernetes using Kyverno and/or Open Policy Agent (OPA / Gatekeeper) — e.g. image provenance, resource limits, security baselines.
* Familiarity with Knative or similar Kubernetes\-native serverless/eventing frameworks for scale\-to\-zero or request\-driven workloads.
* Experience building, hardening, and optimizing container images (Dockerfile best practices,
  

minimal/hardened base images such as Docker Hardened Images or Chainguard).
* Working knowledge of an observability stack — Grafana, Prometheus, and Alertmanager — plus exposure to Datadog and/or VictoriaLogs/VictoriaMetrics, and practical experience instrumenting services and pipelines with OpenTelemetry (traces, metrics, logs).
* Comfortable in Linux/Unix environments, with solid scripting ability (e.g. Bash, Python, or Go) and strong Git fundamentals.
* AWS cloud experience (compute, storage/S3, networking fundamentals) is a plus.

**Soft skills**


* Genuine product mindset toward internal platforms: you think in terms of the engineer as a customer, and you seek out and act on their feedback.
* Strong cross\-functional collaborator, comfortable embedding with a product engineering team and building trust with people who don’t share your infrastructure background.
* Clear written and verbal communicator, able to explain infrastructure concepts (e.g. Kubernetes, runner sizing, build performance) to engineers without a platform background, and able to tailor the level of detail to the audience.
* Pragmatic and cost\-conscious: able to balance reliability, security, developer speed, and infrastructure cost, and to make and explain trade\-offs rather than defaulting to “more resources.”
* Ownership mindset with strong personal accountability; comfortable working autonomously and
  

driving initiatives from discovery through to rollout.

Manufacturing Test Software Engineer
**Description \-**

We are looking for a Manufacturing Test Software Engineer to join our team and help develop reliable, scalable, and high\-quality manufacturing test solutions for HP products.


In this role, you will work with product development, factory, quality, and external partners to design, implement, validate, and improve test software used in manufacturing. You will support both new product introduction and sustaining programs, helping to ensure product quality, production readiness, and factory efficiency.


This role is ideal for junior\-to\-mid level engineers who enjoy software development, test automation, problem solving, and working closely with both engineering and manufacturing teams. You will also have opportunities to work with emerging technologies such as AI, machine learning, image processing, and advanced automation to improve test coverage, strengthen defect detection, and optimize manufacturing efficiency.


Engineers with strong programming fundamentals and a keen interest in test automation, embedded systems, image processing, or AI/ML applications are also welcome to apply.


Key Responsibilities


* Develop and support manufacturing test solutions with product development and production teams to ensure product quality, performance, and manufacturability.
* Design, implement, and validate test software for new and existing products across mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, and system\-level requirements.
* Work with internal teams and external partners to support project execution, production readiness, and issue resolution.
* Support the creation, validation, and delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and high\-quality manufacturing test packages.
* Represent the manufacturing test team in project discussions, technical reviews, and issue\-resolution forums.
* Provide training, documentation, and technical support to users within and outside HP.
* Improve test software robustness and support factory and quality teams in troubleshooting production issues.
* Analyze test failures, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to product design, test coverage, and manufacturing quality.
* Optimize test solutions to improve throughput, reduce test cycle time, and enhance factory productivity.

Knowledge and Skills


* Experience or strong interest in software development, test automation, embedded systems, firmware, image processing, AI/ML, and autonomous or agentic solutions.
* Programming knowledge in languages and tools such as Python, SQL, VB, C\#, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with data analysis, software testing methodology, test plan execution, debugging, test scripts, and automation tools.
* Interest or exposure to Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts and related frameworks will be an advantage.
* Ability to understand software, hardware, and system\-level requirements and translate them into practical test solutions.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and adapt to changing requirements.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English and local language.
* Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and work effectively with cross\-functional teams.

* Supports product quality, manufacturing readiness, delivery timelines, and factory efficiency.

jobs.title: Civil Site Engineer in Bulgaria - Επιβλέπων Μηχανικός Εργοταξίου στην Βουλγαρία
jobs.description:
**CIVIL SITE ENGINEER / WORKS SUPERVISOR**

  

  

**EGNATIA BULGARIA LTD \| Projects Across Bulgaria**

  

  

**www.group\-egnatia.bg**

  

**Where Engineering Meets Execution.**

  

  

**Delivering Projects. Building Careers.**

  

  

Egnatia Bulgaria, part of the Egnatia Group, is an international EPC contractor providing Engineering, Procurement, Construction (EPC) and Operation \& Maintenance (O\&M) services across the energy, infrastructure, telecommunications, industrial, commercial and residential sectors.

  

  

With more than 25 years of presence in Southeast Europe, we deliver technically demanding projects with a strong focus on quality, safety, reliability and engineering excellence.

  

  

As part of our continued growth, we are looking for Civil Site Engineers / Works Supervisors to join our project teams throughout Bulgaria.

  

  

The position is suitable both for engineers who already have site supervision experience and for motivated professionals who want to further develop their career in construction and project execution within an international EPC environment.

  

  

**The Role**

  

  

You will be responsible for the on\-site supervision and coordination of civil works across a variety of Egnatia Bulgaria projects, including energy and renewable energy projects, infrastructure, industrial facilities, buildings and commercial or residential fit\-outs.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

  

* On\-site supervision of civil construction activities.
* Supervision of earthworks, excavations, grading and site preparation.
* Supervision of concrete works, foundations and structural works.
* Supervision of roads, drainage systems, fencing and associated infrastructure works.
* Supervision of civil and architectural works in building and fit\-out projects, where applicable.
* Coordination and daily follow\-up of subcontractors, site crews and suppliers.
* Verification that works are executed according to drawings, technical specifications and project requirements.
* Monitoring of quantities, productivity, quality and construction progress.
* Identification and reporting of technical or site\-related issues.
* Coordination with Project Managers, engineers, designers and other project disciplines.
* Monitoring compliance with site HSE and quality requirements.
* Preparation of daily/weekly progress updates, site records, photographic documentation and technical reports.

  

  

**Requirements**

  

  

* Degree in Civil Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
* Previous construction/site experience will be considered an advantage; the level of responsibility will be adapted to the candidate’s experience.
* Good command of English, written and spoken, is required.
* Knowledge of Bulgarian will be considered a strong asset.
* Ability to read and understand technical drawings and specifications.
* Good organisational, communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary project team.
* Willingness to work on and travel between project sites throughout Bulgaria.
* Valid Category B driving licence.

  

  

**What We Offer**

  

  

* Net monthly salary: **€1,500–€2,500**, depending on experience, qualifications and level of responsibility.
* Accommodation provided in the vicinity the projects
* Company vehicle according to the requirements of the position.
* Laptop and mobile phone.
* Access to modern site supervision and engineering tools, including surveying GPS equipment, drones and digital reporting tools.
* Continuous training and hands\-on technical development.
* Strong engineering and technical support from experienced project teams.
* Exposure to different types and scales of EPC projects.
* Opportunities for increased responsibility and long\-term career development within the Egnatia Group.

  

  

**Location**

  

  

The position is based on project sites throughout **Bulgaria.** Accommodation and transportation support are provided according to project requirements.

  

  

**Join Our Team**

  

  

If you are interested in developing your career through hands\-on involvement in challenging engineering and construction projects, we would like to hear from you.

  

  

  

**ΕΠΙΒΛΕΠΩΝ ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΣ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟΥ – ΠΟΛΙΤΙΚΟΣ ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΣ (CIVIL SITE ENGINEER)**

  

  

**EGNATIA BULGARIA LTD \| Έργα σε όλη τη Βουλγαρία**

  

  

**Where Engineering Meets Execution.**

  

  

**Delivering Projects. Building Careers.**

  

  

Η **Egnatia Bulgaria**, μέλος του **Egnatia Group**, είναι διεθνής **EPC Contractor**, παρέχοντας ολοκληρωμένες υπηρεσίες Engineering, Procurement \& Construction (EPC) καθώς και Operation \& Maintenance (O\&M) στους τομείς της ενέργειας, των υποδομών, των τηλεπικοινωνιών, των βιομηχανικών, εμπορικών και οικιστικών έργων.

  

  

Με περισσότερα από 25 χρόνια παρουσίας στη Νοτιοανατολική Ευρώπη, υλοποιούμε τεχνικά απαιτητικά έργα με ιδιαίτερη έμφαση στην ποιότητα, την ασφάλεια, την αξιοπιστία και την τεχνική αρτιότητα.

  

  

Στο πλαίσιο της συνεχούς ανάπτυξής μας, αναζητούμε Πολιτικούς Μηχανικούς για επίβλεψη εργασιών εργοταξίου (Civil Site Engineers / Works Supervisors), οι οποίοι θα ενταχθούν στις ομάδες έργων μας σε όλη τη Βουλγαρία.

  

  

Η θέση απευθύνεται τόσο σε μηχανικούς με εμπειρία στην επίβλεψη εργοταξιακών εργασιών όσο και σε μηχανικούς με μικρότερη εμπειρία, οι οποίοι επιθυμούν να εξελιχθούν επαγγελματικά στον τομέα των κατασκευών και της υλοποίησης έργων σε ένα διεθνές EPC περιβάλλον.

  

  

**Ο Ρόλος**

  

  

Ο/Η μηχανικός θα είναι υπεύθυνος/η για την επιτόπου επίβλεψη και τον συντονισμό εργασιών πολιτικού μηχανικού σε διαφορετικούς τύπους έργων της Egnatia Bulgaria, όπως έργα ενέργειας και Ανανεώσιμων Πηγών Ενέργειας, υποδομών, βιομηχανικών εγκαταστάσεων, κτιριακών έργων καθώς και εμπορικών και οικιστικών fit\-out projects.

  

  

**Κύριες Αρμοδιότητες**

  

  

* Επιτόπου επίβλεψη εργασιών πολιτικού μηχανικού.
* Επίβλεψη χωματουργικών εργασιών, εκσκαφών, διαμορφώσεων και προετοιμασίας εργοταξίου.
* Επίβλεψη εργασιών σκυροδέματος, θεμελιώσεων και δομικών κατασκευών.
* Επίβλεψη οδοποιίας, αποστραγγιστικών έργων, περιφράξεων και συναφών έργων υποδομής.
* Επίβλεψη οικοδομικών και αρχιτεκτονικών εργασιών σε κτιριακά και fit\-out έργα, όπου απαιτείται.
* Συντονισμός και καθημερινή παρακολούθηση υπεργολάβων, συνεργείων και προμηθευτών.
* Έλεγχος της εκτέλεσης των εργασιών σύμφωνα με τα σχέδια, τις τεχνικές προδιαγραφές και τις απαιτήσεις του έργου.
* Παρακολούθηση ποσοτήτων, παραγωγικότητας, ποιότητας και προόδου των εργασιών.
* Εντοπισμός και αναφορά τεχνικών θεμάτων ή προβλημάτων του εργοταξίου.
* Συνεργασία και συντονισμός με Project Managers, μηχανικούς, μελετητές και τις υπόλοιπες ειδικότητες του έργου.
* Παρακολούθηση της συμμόρφωσης με τις απαιτήσεις Υγείας \& Ασφάλειας (HSE) και Ποιότητας.
* Προετοιμασία ημερήσιων και εβδομαδιαίων αναφορών προόδου, αρχείων εργοταξίου, φωτογραφικής τεκμηρίωσης και τεχνικών reports.

  

  

**Απαραίτητα Προσόντα**

  

  

* Πτυχίο Πολιτικού Μηχανικού ή συναφούς τεχνικής ειδικότητας.
* Προηγούμενη εμπειρία σε κατασκευαστικά έργα ή/και εργοτάξιο θα θεωρηθεί επιπλέον προσόν. Το επίπεδο ευθύνης της θέσης θα προσαρμόζεται ανάλογα με την εμπειρία του υποψηφίου.
* Απαραίτητη η καλή γνώση Αγγλικών, σε γραπτό και προφορικό επίπεδο.
* Η γνώση Βουλγαρικών θα θεωρηθεί σημαντικό πρόσθετο προσόν.
* Ικανότητα ανάγνωσης και κατανόησης τεχνικών σχεδίων και προδιαγραφών.
* Καλές οργανωτικές, επικοινωνιακές και πρακτικές δεξιότητες επίλυσης προβλημάτων.
* Ικανότητα αποτελεσματικής συνεργασίας στο πλαίσιο διεπιστημονικής ομάδας έργου.
* Δυνατότητα εργασίας και μετακίνησης μεταξύ εργοταξίων σε όλη τη Βουλγαρία.
* Άδεια οδήγησης κατηγορίας Β.

  

  

**Τι Προσφέρουμε**

  

  

* Καθαρές μηνιαίες αποδοχές **€1\.500–€2\.500**, ανάλογα με την εμπειρία, τα προσόντα και το επίπεδο ευθύνης.
* Παροχή διαμονής στην ευρύτερη περιοχή του εκάστοτε έργου.
* Εταιρικό όχημα, ανάλογα με τις απαιτήσεις της θέσης.
* Laptop και κινητό τηλέφωνο.
* Πρόσβαση σε σύγχρονο εξοπλισμό και τεχνολογίες επίβλεψης έργων, όπως τοπογραφικά GPS, drones και ψηφιακά εργαλεία reporting.
* Συνεχής εκπαίδευση και πρακτική τεχνική εξέλιξη.
* Ισχυρή τεχνική και μηχανολογική υποστήριξη από έμπειρες ομάδες έργων.
* Συμμετοχή σε διαφορετικού τύπου και κλίμακας EPC projects.
* Δυνατότητα ανάληψης αυξημένων αρμοδιοτήτων και μακροχρόνιας επαγγελματικής εξέλιξης εντός του Egnatia Group.

  

  

**Τόπος Εργασίας**

  

  

Η θέση αφορά εργοτάξια σε όλη τη **Βουλγαρία**. Παρέχεται διαμονή και υποστήριξη μετακίνησης ανάλογα με τις απαιτήσεις και την τοποθεσία του εκάστοτε έργου.

  

  

**Join Our Team**

  

  

Εάν επιθυμείτε να εξελίξετε την επαγγελματική σας πορεία μέσα από ενεργή συμμετοχή σε απαιτητικά τεχνικά και κατασκευαστικά έργα, θα χαρούμε να σας γνωρίσουμε.

  

  

Σας ευχαριστούμε για τον χρόνο σας

* MFA: **FIDO2, Push, OTP/TOTP, SMS.**

* LDAP, REST APIs, SCIM, Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC).
* **Git/GitLab**, Docker, Ansible, Bruno.

* Hands\-on experience in **IAM / Ping Identity** technologies.

* Experience across development, project implementation, and production support activities.
* **Fluent professional English** and experience working with international teams.

* Business logic knowledge and IT Relations.

TRANSVERSAL SKILLS

BEHAVIORAL SKILLS


* Ability to understand, explain, and support solution evolutions.
* Ability to meet objectives / Result orientation.
* With attention to detail/ Rigorous.
* Collaboration and teamwork.

* Client focused.
* Effective communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Proactivity.

* You are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* You have strong problem\-solving skills and high attention to detail.
* You demonstrate effective communication and teamwork abilities.

We are BNP Paribas, a leading international bank present in 64 countries. We support our clients through financing, investment, savings, and insurance services, maintaining key positions in Corporate \& Institutional Banking.

https://group.bnpparibas/en/our\-commitments/inclusion/diversity\-equality\-and\-inclusion

* The Human Resources team will contact you to confirm key details about the position.


* After this initial contact, interviews will be conducted with the relevant business area.

jobs.title: Fullstack .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Een positieve toekomst voor iedereen daar werken we bij Sopra Steria aan. Met meer dan 56.000 collega's in 30 landen zijn we Europa's toonaangevende leverancier van digitale oplossingen. Wij weten als geen ander dat het niet alleen technologie is die transformatie aanstuurt. Het zijn mensen die de kern van verandering vormen. Daarom zijn het mensen die centraal staan in alles wat we doen en bieden we een ondersteunende en inclusieve omgeving waar iedereen zowel individueel als in teamverband kan uitblinken.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Heb jij een passie voor Microsoft-technologie en wil je jouw backend-expertise combineren met de dynamiek van moderne frontend-frameworks? Binnen de Microsoft Area van Sopra Steria werk je samen met ervaren engineers aan complexe, impactvolle projecten voor klanten binnen defensie, de publieke sector, financiële dienstverlening en de industrie. Hier combineer je end-to-end vakmanschap met échte maatschappelijke impact en maak je dagelijks het verschil!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Fullstack Developer werk je in multidisciplinaire DevOps-teams aan complexe IT-vraagstukken. Je bent de brug tussen een ijzersterke .NET backend en een intuïtieve, moderne frontend. Je ontwikkelt toekomstbestendige oplossingen en levert code waar je trots op bent: schoon, onderhoudbaar, goed getest en klaar voor de toekomst.

Kwaliteit staat voorop. Geen snelle fixes, maar doordachte oplossingen. Je denkt actief mee over software-architectuur, designkeuzes en technische standaarden, waarbij je zowel de logica in de backend als de performance in de frontend bewaakt.

Een voorbeeld van een opdracht kan het volgende inhouden:

Migraties & Modernisering: Een verouderde Microsoft .NET applicatie (met bijvoorbeeld .NET Framework 4.8) migreren naar .NET 8, en tegelijkertijd de user interface herbouwen in een modern JavaScript-framework zoals Angular, React of Vue.
Cloud & Architectuur: Een nieuwe Azure-omgeving inrichten met Infrastructure as Code (IaC), waarbij je microservices in .NET naadloos laat communiceren met een schaalbare frontend.
Security & Optimalisatie: MFA implementeren in een bestaande applicatie en de API-performance optimaliseren om de laadtijden in de browser drastisch te verkorten.

Functie-eisen

Wat neem jij mee?

Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als .NET Developer, met sterke kennis van .NET (C#) en moderne .NET Core/.NET 8 architecturen en bij voorkeur ervaring met Azure DevOps en/of Github. Werk jij er nog niet mee? Dan sta jij ervoor open om dit snel eigen te maken.
Naast een sterke backend (.NET)-basis, beschik jij ook over aantoonbare kennis van en ervaring met ten minste één modern JavaScript-framework (zoals Angular, React of Vue).
Ervaring met werken in een Agile/Scrum-omgeving en gewend om samen te werken binnen een DevOps-team.
Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Informatica (of vergelijkbaar), communiceert goed in het Nederlands en werkt graag samen in een team waar kennisdeling centraal staat.
Jij hebt een positieve, oplossingsgerichte mindset en vindt het belangrijk om kwalitatief goede, onderhoudbare code te schrijven.
Jij blijft jezelf ontwikkelen, volgt technologische ontwikkelingen actief, bent gemotiveerd om certificeringen te behalen en het lijkt jou gaaf om onderdeel te worden van onze Microsoft Community waarin kennisdeling centraal staat.

Aanvullende informatie

Dit krijg je van ons!

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

Een vast contract en een salaris tussen de €4.000,- en €6.000,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week, dienstverband minimaal 32 uur).
Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol.
Vakantiegeld van 8%;
Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten;
Een mobiliteitsregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatieve vervoersregeling, passend bij jouw situatie;
27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen aan- of te verkopen;
Flexibele hybride werkomstandigheden: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant, afhankelijk van de functie en de mogelijkheden binnen opdrachten;
Een thuiswerkpakket met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
Volop mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, certificeringen, kennissessies en inspirerende events;
Diverse sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van informele borrels tot sportieve en inhoudelijke evenementen;
Mogelijkheden voor fiscaal vriendelijke aflossing van jouw studieschuld;
Een uitgebreid aanbod aan voordelen via ons cafetariamodel, waaronder een fietsregeling, sportabonnementen, zonnepanelen en collectieve verzekeringen;
Een pensioenregeling met een werkgeversbijdrage en de mogelijkheid om vrijwillig aanvullende pensioenopbouw te realiseren.
Bij Sopra Steria geloven we in continue groei. Je krijgt de ruimte om je verder te specialiseren binnen Microsoft-technologie en certificeringen te behalen én te onderhouden, zoals AI-200 en AZ-400.

Wat ons écht onderscheidt?

Bij ons draait het niet alleen om projecten, maar ook om jouw groei als Microsoft professional. Je krijgt een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan, begeleiding van ervaren specialisten en alle ruimte om door te groeien naar een volgende stap, technisch én professioneel.

Met meer dan 180 Microsoft-specialisten werk je in één van de grootste Microsoft-communities van Nederland. Van .NET en software-architectuur tot Power Platform, Data & AI en Security kennis is hier overal. We hebben meerdere MVP’s en MCT’s in huis en zijn trots Microsoft Solution Partner.

Kennisdeling en plezier. Maandelijkse track-meetings, inspiratiesessies en een actief Inspirator- en accelerator programma helpen je om jezelf én anderen beter te maken. En natuurlijk bezoeken we samen toonaangevende conferenties zoals Future Tech en maken we ook tijd voor teamuitjes die je niet snel vergeet.

Klaar om te groeien?
 Klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging bij een bedrijf dat net zo in beweging is als jij? Neem contact op met Mathilda van Delden: mathilda.vandelden@soprasteria.com of solliciteer direct. We kijken ernaar uit je te ontmoeten!

Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

We are significantly increasing our focus on AI-assisted development across Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can improve the software development lifecycle – from understanding requirements and exploring technical approaches to coding, testing, review, debugging, refactoring, and automation.

We do not see AI as a replacement for strong engineering fundamentals. We see it as a tool that can make capable developers more effective when combined with technical judgment and a clear understanding of the problem being solved.

As an experienced developer, we want you to take an active role in this development: experimenting with new workflows, critically evaluating their value, sharing what works, and helping us establish good engineering practices around AI-assisted development.

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
GitHub CoPilot
MSSQL
Elasticsearch
AWS

Our product teams bring developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers together.

Have strong software engineering fundamentals
Are comfortable owning complex technical problems and decisions
Care about maintainability, reliability, performance, and quality

Are interested in how AI and new development tools can improve your effectiveness as an engineer

Dalux is a software company at heart.

Significant ownership of the software you build
Real influence on technical solutions and engineering practices
Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge
Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design
Short paths from technical ideas to decisions and implementation
Opportunities to drive improvements beyond your immediate product work
An environment actively investing in AI-assisted software development
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems

Work directly with enterprise customers to understand their processes and goals. Design and implement solutions using Maisa Studio to automate complex workflows, acting as a trusted technical partner during onboarding and deployment while translating requirements into technical implementations and product feedback.

Partner with product and engineering teams to influence roadmap development. Surface customer needs, edge cases, and scalability concerns while defining best practices, reference architectures, and reusable components that accelerate delivery.

Ensure deployments meet enterprise standards for reliability, performance, and security. Support customers in regulated environments by aligning with compliance requirements and collaborating with QA, SRE, and AppSec teams for stable rollouts.

You have strong experience as a Software Engineer, Solutions Engineer, DevOps/SRE Engineer, or Forward Deployed Engineer in customer-facing or delivery-oriented roles. Integrations & Supporting Services (Build what makes the use case work)

Strong experience as a backend or full-stack developer shipping production systems.
Hands-on experience with APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures/queues.
Familiarity with serverless and integration patterns commonly used in enterprise environments.
Strong debugging skills and comfort operating across code, infrastructure touchpoints, and workflow logic.

Strong experience in DevOps / SRE, supporting production workloads.
Hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes, cloud providers and/or on-prem infrastructure, and networking fundamentals.
Practical experience with security and identity standards: OIDC, SAML, VPNs, certificates, and IAM concepts.
Ability to quickly understand customer infrastructure and adapt to their tools and processes.
Clear, structured communication with technical stakeholders in customer organizations.

You will be joining one of Europe’s most exciting early-stage AI start-ups, where you’ll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge Agentic Process Automation that’s reshaping how enterprises approach AI deployment. You will get to directly influence how major multinational organizations transform critical business processes, working on genuinely differentiated technology that solves real enterprise AI challenges.

Following our recent $25m Seed Round, backed by leading Venture Capital firms including Creandum, Forgepoint, NFX, and Village Global, we’re scaling quickly and realising significant enterprise traction. This is your opportunity to help solve real AI enterprise challenges, working alongside deep technical and industry experts, where you will be challenged daily and expedite your learning and development.

Maisa is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all.
